title: רב אבא אבוה דרב בריה דרב משרשיא

paragraphs: Rav Abba, father of Rav, son of Rav Mesharshya: “Thus we say in Rava’s name,” Eruvin 24, end of a. So in two printed editions, and there is a scribal error here. I saw in Yuchasin, letter mem: “Rav Mesharshya bar Rav, chapter Osin Passin.” End quotation. Perhaps it should read “Rabbi Abba, father of Rav, father of Rav Mesharshya,” or “Rabbi Abba bar Rav Mesharshya bar Rav.” The new Talmud editions did not correct it. Alternatively, we find Rav Acha bar Rav, and also his son Rav Mesharshya (see there). Perhaps Rav Acha bar Rav had a son called Rav after his father, and that Rav had a son called Rav Mesharshya. It should then read “Rav Acha, father of Rav, who was father of Rav Mesharshya” (see below, Rav Bibi bar Rav Mesharshya).
